title: Cloning ecGReg, bpeGReg or truncated genes into pTrc99A or pET-3a vectors
author: Xuehua Wan
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.ijxccpn
materials: PCR products were purified using the QIAquick PCR Purification Kit (Qiagen). The 50 μl PCR product was mixed with 250 μl of Buffer PB, incubated at room temperature for two minutes, applied to a QIAquick spin column, and centrifuged for one minute at 14,000 rpm. The flow-through was discarded and the bound DNA was washed twice with 750 μl Buffer PE. After the flow-through was discarded, the column was centrifuged for additional one minute to remove residual ethanol. The QIAquick column was placed in a clean microcentrifuge tube and air-dried for 20 minutes. To elute, 30 μl of ddH2O was added to the center of the QIAquick membrane, allowed to stand for two minutes, and then centrifuged for one minute at 14,000 rpm.

Plasmids were isolated using the QIAprep Spin Miniprep Kit (Qiagen). Single colonies were inoculated into 2 ml of CircleGrow medium and incubated overnight at 37 °C with shaking. The cells were harvested by centrifugation and the cell pellet was resuspended with 250 μl of Buffer P1. Then, 250 μl of Buffer P2 was added and the tubes were gently inverted for 4-6 times to mix. After 5 minutes, 350 μl of Buffer N3 was added and mixed thoroughly by inverting the tubes. The tubes were incubated at 4 °C for 10-15 minutes and then centrifuged at 14,000 rpm for 10 minutes at 4 °C to remove the precipitated cell debris, proteins, and genomic DNA. The supernatant was transferred to clean tubes and centrifuged at 14,000 rpm for 15 minutes at 4 °C. The supernatant was transferred to QIAprep spin columns, centrifuged at 14,000 rpm for one minute at room temperature, and the flow-through was discarded. The columns were washed twice by adding 750 μl of Buffer PE and centrifuging for one minute. After the second wash, the column was centrifuged for an additional one minute, transferred to a clean microcentrifuge tube, and air-dried for 45 minutes. The plasmid DNA was eluted with 35 μl of Buffer EB.

steps.title: Amplify genes by PCR
steps.instruction: Set up a 50 µl PCR reaction containing 1 µl DNA template, 5 µl 10× Pfu buffer, 1 µl 10 mM dNTPs, 2 µl DMSO, 1 µl Primer 1 (10 pmol/µl), 1 µl Primer 2 (10 pmol/µl), 38 µl ddH₂O and 1 µl PfuTurbo DNA polymerase (2.5 U/µl). Perform a hot‑start at 94 °C for 2 min, then 25–30 cycles of 94 °C 30 s, 55 °C (range 45–62 °C according to primer Tm) 30 s, 72 °C 1–3 min, followed by a final extension at 72 °C for 7 min.

steps.title: Check PCR product
steps.instruction: Run an aliquot of the PCR reaction on an agarose gel electrophoresis to verify product size and purity.

steps.title: TOPO‑clone blunt PCR product
steps.instruction: Mix the purified blunt‑end PCR product with pCR4Blunt‑TOPO vector (volumes not specified) and incubate the mixture at room temperature for 5–30 min.

steps.title: Transform TOPO reaction
steps.instruction: Add the TOPO cloning mixture to 25 µl TOP10 or Mach1‑T1R competent cells, incubate on ice 20–30 min, heat‑shock at 42 °C for 45 s, place on ice 2 min, add 200 µl LB medium and recover at 37 °C with shaking for 1 h. Centrifuge at 5,000 rpm for 2 min, resuspend the pellet in ~50 µl LB, spread on 1.2 % agar plates containing the appropriate antibiotic, and incubate at 37 °C for 10–16 h.

steps.title: Digest vector and dephosphorylate
steps.instruction: Set up a preparative restriction‑enzyme digestion (enzyme(s) at 10 U/µl, 10× enzyme buffer, ddH₂O, DNA; volumes not specified) and incubate in a 37 °C water bath for 1 h. Add 1 µl alkaline phosphatase (1 U/µl) to the reaction and incubate an additional 1 h at 37 °C to dephosphorylate the vector.

steps.title: Purify digested DNA from gel
steps.instruction: Run the digested DNA on an agarose gel, excise the desired band and place it in a Geneclean Spin filter. Add 400 µl Geneclean Spin Glassmilk, heat at 55 °C while mixing every 2 min to melt the gel, then centrifuge at 14,000 rpm for 1 min and discard the flow‑through. Add 400 µl ice‑cold Geneclean Spin New Wash, centrifuge 14,000 rpm for 1 min and discard the flow‑through; repeat this wash three more times (total four washes). Centrifuge the filter 1 min, transfer to a new tube and heat at 55 °C until residual ethanol evaporates and the glassmilk becomes loose. Elute DNA with 15 µl ddH₂O, stand 1–2 min, and centrifuge 1 min to collect the eluate.

steps.title: Ligate insert into vector
steps.instruction: Set up a ligation reaction (components: 10× T4 DNA ligase buffer, T4 DNA ligase, purified DNA; volumes not specified) and incubate overnight at 14 °C.

steps.title: Repeat digestion and ligation
steps.instruction: If necessary, repeat the restriction‑digestion/dephosphorylation step (step 5) and the overnight ligation step (step 7) as described.
